full_page.content:
1931, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5
Page 5 Cont.
Dec. 6 Child - 2 - never walked or spoke - not Catholic and never baptized.
9 Laurence Mousseau - 4 - walking at last ... says a word or two ... pray.
Mrs. Julia Collins - 52 - heart trouble & ankles ... etc.
Walter Kush - 24 - broke leg j yr. ago ... enrolled when Dr's in- sisted on amputating same .... Comes To-day OK.
Page 6 Dec. 10 Mrs. Cath. Cunningham 49 - 9423 Henley Pl. - Fearing cancer on breast promises two perpetual enrollments if things went better ... Her husband and son are enrolled To-day.
Dec. 11 Edw'd Schmelling - 51 - flue - pneum'ia "hopeless ... Enrolled To- day 8:45 A.m.
Dec. 13 Fred Henry - 40 - hemoraging terribly Nov. 19th, hopeless; is en- rolled in S.M.A .... Reported To=day recovered
Now little Daughter very sick - is enrolled Dec. 16, 1931 - Recovering.
Bernard Capler - 19 - Nowin Ionia - Feeble-minded. Wants to get to St. Jos.
Genevieve Palace - 26 - Northville, fears operation ... Sister was 1 year out there, Now O.K. Deo. G.
Dec. 15 M. Boismier & Mrs. - becoming old not able to care for daughter - 39 - who was struck by lightening when a baby and has remained childish. Pray that they may be able to sell before losing property.
Page 7 Dec. 15 % phone Chr's Hewitt - 11 - run down and in Hospital unconscious since last Saturday ... is enrolled To-day by phone.
Ray Garland - Mt. Vernon Mem. Pk. - after 2 weeks without a car got a good one finally.
Mrs. Anna Mok - 43 - 10 children living. . . nerveous . .
Mrs. Foley also nerveous
Pneumonia, Mrs. Breese, very low with Pneu'a-(has 10 children) now in East side Hosp .....
